en: Oh, that could be fun! I'll have to get myself out there as soon as possible! <Color:255,200,200,255>⑮<Color:Default>
Maybe you can start by going to wherever that old lady was trying to get to?
Good idea! I've been curious about it myself ever since! I'll be sure to learn the way so I can give people directions next time!
Did you come to Kamurocho much before you started working here?
Oh yeah. I'd come here to sing karaoke a lot.
You came all the way from Saitama just for karaoke?
This was always the easiest place for my online friends to meet up, so we'd wind up gathering here.
My local friends would never come all the way out here.
Online friends? I suppose that's pretty typical these days, isn't it?
In sheer numbers, I have way more online friends than I do from school.
So because of that, Kamurocho is less of a nightlife spot and more where I hang out during the day.
That's unusual. Kamurocho is the city that never sleeps. I think most folks would consider it a nightlife spot.
Since I work nights in the club, I don't go out drinking much at night. But after I get off work, I might go early in the morning.
I see. You're more of a resident of the neighborhood than a visitor, so I suppose it's natural you'd have a different perspective.
You're a nighttime sort of guy, aren't you, Kiryu-san?
I am. I like strolling through the busy streets, bathed in bright neon lights. I don't get the same energy from the sparse daytime crowds.
I get you. When night comes around, more people like you come out to the streets! <Color:255,200,200,255>⑮<Color:Default>
That's one way to put it.
The nightlife is good, too. Men have the hostesses, women have the hosts. Are you into hosts?
I've seen them a few times, but it's never really gone well.
Oh? Why's that?
I guess lots of guys who are hosts are really narcissistic.
I mean, I like a guy that's hot and all, but not if they're the kind who act like they're cooler than everyone else.
You prefer a man who's humble?
Yeah, exactly. That's why I prefer to go to bars with hot bartenders, rather than host clubs.
There's got to be places like that around here somewhere. You should go look for them.
Times have changed. Back in my day, this wasn't the sort of place where respectable people would hang out so casually.
Really? When did that start to change?
I wonder. I was away for a long time, so I don't know much about what happened during my absence.
Oh, right. You moved to Okinawa, didn't you?
No, that was much more recent. I'm talking about a time much farther in my past.
Hey, are you keeping secrets from me?
I'll just say, there was a time when I was away from Kamurocho for ten years. After all that time, it's natural for the town to have changed.
Hey, not so fast! You can't just dodge the question like that!
You know, I've been fascinated with hostesses since I was little. My grade school graduation essay was even about how I dreamed of becoming one in the future.
Since you were a little girl? Weren't you a bit young to know about that?
No way, I saw stuff about it on TV all the time! Honestly, I never really gave much thought to any other line of work.
Then that means you're already living the dream, doesn't it?
Yeah, exactly! I put together a résumé, went in for an interview, and that was that. It was almost too easy!
Hmm. But is it really a dream if you didn't have to do anything difficult to get it? I guess it might still be.
But then you've got your whole life ahead of you, without anything to work for.
That's why, at least for now, I'm aiming to be the number one girl at the club.
It's good to have goals. People can't grow if they never challenge themselves.
Right! Hey, while we're at it, do you want me to set a goal for you, Kiryu-san?
A goal for me? What does that mean?
That means you're going to help me become the number one girl! How's that sound?
Don't be ridiculous. It's your job to make me want to do that.
But you <Italic>do</Italic> still want me to become number one, don't you?
Not really...
Aw, come on. Everyone needs goals in life, right? I think you're better off helping me out than you are doing nothing.
Hm. I suppose that is the sort of perseverance you need to make your dreams come true.
You should aim higher. A goal like that is hardly worth shooting for.
What? How come?
Because you'll probably become the number one girl at this club in no time. And then what will you do?
Hahaha! Oh, that's silly. You haven't known me long enough to drop that kind of line!
It's not flattery. I really do believe that.
Well, I guess if it seems that easy to you, it's bound to happen. Maybe I really should pick something more difficult.
There's nothing wrong with that goal, but don't limit yourself to just that. It's better to try lots of different things.
You're right. I'll have to think of other goals to go after!
Is that all? Why was that what you decided to shoot for?
I mean, I'm a hostess, after all. Isn't that a normal thing for me to want?
But that's what every hostess wants. You get a higher ranking just by being good at your job, and the longer you do it the better you naturally get.
Isn't there something else that you've dreamed of? Something that's more personal to you?
I mean, not really. But isn't it kinda wrong to think about my next goal before I even reach my current one?
Think of it this way. You've got short, medium, and long-term goals. Hitting number one should be part of that bigger goal.
Oh, I don't need all that. If my dreams don't come true, then they don't come true. It doesn't have to be more complicated than that.
Hmph. I would have thought you'd be more passionate about this kind of thing, but I guess I was wrong.
Have you already been out drinking today?
No, I'm just heading out now.
I see! Well, I'm sure you'll like this place!
Is there a hostess you'd recommend?
I'm not sure if she's working today, but there's a girl named Riku-chan who comes highly praised.
Riku, huh?
Born and raised right here in Hakata! She's very sociable and enjoys nice, friendly conversation.
She might seem like she's got it together, but she's not perfect. I think she'd appreciate it if you were supportive when you talk to her.
In addition, her blood type is B, and she's a twenty-year-old Cancer! I don't know what sort of things she likes, but you can probably find out by talking to her.
You seem to know quite a bit about her.
I actually visited her once, myself.
So you have the most accurate information, then.
Of course! I can hardly recommend a girl to a customer without first-hand experience!
Where are you in town from, sir?
Tokyo.
Tokyo, really? I'm from Tokyo myself, actually.
Oh yeah? What're ya doin' in Tsukimino, then?
Well... it's something of a delicate subject. I'll just say, certain things kept me from sticking around Honshu.
Uh, I'll change the subject. What sorta club are ya takin' me to? The girls there any good?
I'm not sure what your tastes are, sir, but personally, I would recommend Kaguya-chan.
Kaguya, eh?
(Kaguya's the same girl that Himura recommended, right?)
Oh, yes! She's pin-up girl material, with a real dynamite body! Just wait 'til you set your eyes on her melons, hehehe.
She also can come off as kind of lackadaisical, but she's actually really smart and a snappy conversationalist. She's pretty popular with the older men.
Lackawhatsical?
I'll just say, she takes things at her own pace, and it's probably not worth trying to lecture her about it.
Not a fan of bein' lectured, then.
She's also blood type A, 26 years old, and a Scorpio. If memory serves me correctly, she's a big lover of chocolate as well.
Business slow today?
No, this is pretty typical. With New Year's Eve right around the corner, normal bars are more likely to be packed.
Have you ever been to Prime?
Yes. Let me think.
Oh, right. There's a girl there named Honoka-chan who's pretty good.
Honoka-chan, huh?
Yes, sir. Like most of the girls in town, she's a real energetic go-getter. And she talks an awful lot, so you'll never be bored.
Heh. Sounds like my kind of girl.
She is known to exaggerate at times, but don't worry about every little detail she says. You're fine so long as you can say something interesting.
That sounds complicated, but okay.
Her blood type is AB, she's a Virgo, and she's 21 years old. Just feed her some pork skewers, and it'll all be A-OK!
Oh, you'll know when you see her.
A cabaret club? That's not your usual go-to place, Shinada-san.
The sex business is just my job. This is personal.
Yeah, all right. Just don't fall for a hostess and go even deeper into debt, okay? Please?
Ha! Do I look like a would-be sugar daddy to you? I don't like girls who are pushy like that anyhow, so don't you worry about me.
Well, I suppose not. I figured that Shion-chan is more of your type, anyway.
Shion-chan, huh? What's she like?
Oh, don't you know her?
No, obviously! Tell me!
Shion-chan is a-MAY-zing! She's gorgeous, refined, and elegant! An honest-to-goodness Nagoya princess!
Oooh! Tell me more!
Her blood type's O, and she's a Gemini, age 24.
What kind of stuff does she like?
Hey, you said you weren't gonna be her sugar daddy!
Calm down, man, I'm just asking what she's interested in!
Well, she's real upper crust. So if you get her a gift that is too common, it may backfire and make her angry.
I bet. What else?
She's rather short-tempered, and saying the wrong thing will set her off. If you think she's mad, you'd better change the subject quick.
Right. Gotta make sure to not get her angry.
Elise has really become something! They've got new girls on staff and they are all top notch!
Any you recommend?
Oh, of course! You've got your pick of lovely ladies who have been scouted from all across Japan!
There's Riku-chan from Nagasugai, Hakata, out in Kyushu. She's a big hit with folks who are all about that perky Hakata dialect of hers!
Is that so.
(Sounds like she's doing a good job.)
There's also Kaguya-chan from Tsukimino, Sapporo! I've heard she's been working as a model lately, with big-name talent scouts coming to see her, too!
Interesting.
(Never expected Saejima to win over such a gem.)
Next, from Sotenbori in Osaka, comes Honoka-chan! Young men are getting worked up by her high-energy Kansai conversation style on a nightly basis!
(Leave it to Akiyama to pick a winner.)
And, last but not least, there's Shion-chan from Kineicho, Nagoya! She's a blonde-haired, half-Japanese bombshell, who is always in demand by well-heeled VIP guests!
(That Shinada's not just some schmuck after all. Maybe I should reconsider my opinion of him.)
Oh! And a special bit of info you can only get here! Today's the big debut of Hinata-chan, their secret weapon, fresh off of training!
Hm. What's she like?
Not much is known yet, other than she's blood type A, 23 years old, and an Aquarius.
But you can be sure she exemplifies what a hostess should be! She really is the "It Girl" of Tokyo right now.
Just go along with the conversation and I think she'll like you just fine. But winning her over will not be easy⑬or cheap.
So I just have to go with the flow...
Well, there's more to her than that. It would be too easy if that's all you had to do.
Gunfire!?
(There are a lot of them.)
(Hm, that float gives me an idea.)
(And it's in the perfect spot, too. Good.)
(The elevator is stopped at the fifth floor and won't come down. I'll have to take the stairs.)
This way, Aniki!
Are you all right, Aniki?
Right as rain.
By the way, what's with the getup?
This? Just camouflage to keep the cops off my tail.
You kind of stick out.
Yeah? Better change, then. Hang on.
This'll work, right? I'll stash the other outfit for now.
No time to waste. Follow me!
Damn it! They're waiting for us here, too!
Only one way through. Let's do this, Baba-chan!
(Tch, there's a cop. Better cross the road and take the long way around.)
(Huh?)
(There's a cop on that side, too!)
(Gotta hide! Wait... Huh?)
(Ain't nowhere to hide, so I need a disguise!)
(This'll work! Sorry, but I gotta borrow this!)
(All right, looks like it worked. I'll give this outfit back later. Gotta find Baba-chan now.)
(There's Baba-chan! Is he lookin' for me?)
(Gotta cross the road and meet up.)
It's quiet.
They're probably all guarding the patriarch's room. That works in our favor.
